issue.title: [CDCSDK] Data loss during snapshot + compaction

repository.name: debezium-connector-yugabytedb
repository.description: A Debezium CDC connector for the YugabyteDB database

issue.body:
During the snapshot operation we should restrict the compaction, to handle that server has implemented _cdcsdk_safe_time_. 
but from the connector side before the snapshot operation start, the connector should call setCDCCheckpoint with _initial_checkpoint as true_ and _cdc_sdk_safe_time as Invalid_, , to handle the data loss, that can be possible in the time gap of _setCDCChecpoint_ and _UpdatePeersAndMetrics_ thread (that update the cdcsdk_safe_time, after the snapshot operation start.), if compaction is run.

This issue is a part of the java and connector changes being done for the server side issue: https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/15562 and https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/15759

issue.title: [CDCSDK] Add a parameter to SetCheckpointRequest to accept cdc_sdk_safe_time

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-5112](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5112)
As part of the java level changes for issue #15562, add the parameter for `cdc_sdk_safe_time` to `SetCheckpointRequest.java` class under `yb-client` module so that the clients can also pass in a safe time while setting the checkpoint.

Do note that the name of the parameter would be `cdcsdkSafeTime` in java owing to the naming conventions we use there.

The tests for the same will be added in the Debezium connector as part of the issue https://github.com/yugabyte/debezium-connector-yugabytedb/issues/143
